about: revmoves2 (2026-11-20; at 1x for the shots: the bridge and what follows it -- the user, round 2: 'I noticed he did this during a pin too'): Ultimo Dragon (Revenge import 0x0376, slot 0, CPU) against Farooq (WrestleMania 2000 import 0x03AA), singles; his back-grapple moves (entries 73-83) done as his entry 75, 'revenge:15e2_15e3@<move>' -- Revenge's Tiger Suplex Pin, No Mercy's 3030 frame for frame (57 frames each side, ending in the bridge the pin's hold goes on from). His slot 75 / 76 played it on 2610 Shin Breaker, a move that doesn't go on to a pin: out of the bridge both men stood up. With the fix it is played on 3030: the bridge goes on to the pin (Ultimo 74, Farooq 75). Shots in the move and the pin. Matches one after another until the time is up.

expect.name: Ultimo did his slot 75 move (2610 before the fix, 3030 after)
his Tiger Suplex Pin went on to its pin (Ultimo 74, Farooq 75)
expect.check: s0_phase == 74 and s1_phase == 75 and (s0_move == 3030 or s0_move == 3031)
